title: Head each dispatch's role list with the cell's own role
action: Slice 3, D3 (store 3c9d6262) with its literal lists fixed by decision 561e1bda. A cell-execution dispatch asks for the ordered list [<the cell's own role>, code, generation]; a read dispatch asks [read, extraction, generation]; a review dispatch asks [review, generation]; the advisor asks [advisor] ALONE with no fall-through, preserving decision 4faf1de9. THE TAIL IS LOAD-BEARING AND NOT DECORATION: fall-through walks to the first name that resolves, so ending a list at code would skip past the generation model every existing host has configured for years and land on bee's built-in default — a silent migration onto a different model, the exact defect this feature exists to remove. Read 561e1bda before changing any list. prepare.rs already prefers a cell's own recorded value over the kind default and stamps tier_source cell (the mechanism mrs-5 extended with --role, stamping tier_source flag); reuse it, do not add a second path. Precedence to preserve: an explicit --role names the slot directly; otherwise the cell's role heads the list; otherwise the kind's default. Record on the cap what tier_source values a caller can now observe and when.

truths: A cell carrying role test resolves models.<runtime>.test when configured
A cell whose role nothing configures falls through to the historical name and runs exactly where it ran before this feature — no host sees a model change without opting in
--role still names the slot directly and outranks the cell's role
The advisor list has no fall-through
The cap names every tier_source value a caller can observe and the condition for each
